title: YOLO Mode Please?
body:
Can we please have a YOLO mode to auto "yes" to all these sorts of things?

```
 Bash command                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  
   bash setup-env.sh                                                                                                             
   Sets up development environment using bash script                                                                              Do you want to proceed?                                                                                                         
 ❯ Yes                                                                                                                           
   Yes, and don't ask again for bash setup-env.sh commands in /dir
   No, and tell Claude what to do differently (esc)
```

Cursor has one and it's great. I'd be OK with not needing one but TUI responsiveness is SLOW and laggy. :(
author: lswank
